# Enerdata: China installs record capacity for solar (+45%) and wind (+18%) in 2024

**Traced to: [48] NEA (official data)**

Published: 22 Jan 2025. Vendor news brief summarizing NEA data. Not an independent source.

## Key Claims (all traceable to NEA [48])
- Installed capacity up **14.6%**, surpassing **3,348 GW**.
- Solar: **45.2% increase (+277 GW)** to **887 GW**.
- Wind: **18% increase (+80 GW)** to ~**521 GW**.
- Hydro: **3.2%** to ~**436 GW**. Nuclear: **6.9%** to ~**61 GW**. Thermal: **3.8%** to >**1,444 GW**.
- 2024 power generation: **9,418 TWh** (+4.6%). Thermal +1.5%, hydro +11%, wind +11%, solar +28%.
- 2024 electricity consumption: **9,852 TWh** (+6.8%).
  - Primary industry: ~136 TWh (+6.3%)
  - Secondary industry: 6,387 TWh (+5.1%)
  - Tertiary industry: 1,835 TWh (+9.9%)
  - Urban/rural residents: 1,494 TWh (+10.6%)
  - Manufacturing: +10%; four largest energy-intensive branches: +2.2%.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: no` — Enerdata is a commercial data vendor.
- All figures trace to NEA official data ([48]).
